title: One step of a decorated configuration
statement: Let $P$ be a finite Turing machine over an alphabet $A$ with $k$ work tapes, and let $l$ be a natural number, $h$ a work-tape index of $P$, $D$ a finite data-state set, $d_0\in D$, and $V$ a visit function of the stated type. For an input word $x$ over $A$, let $c$ be a configuration of $P$ with state $q$, and suppose $c$ is in state $q$; choose $d\in D$, contents $T_i\colon\mathbb Z\to A\cup\{\text{blank}\}$ for the $l$ extra tapes, and an output word $o$. Evaluate $V$ at $q$, $d$, the symbol scanned by $c$, the symbols under its work-tape heads, and the extra-tape symbols at the position of head $h$, obtaining a new data state, one optional write for each extra tape, and an optional output symbol. One step of the decorated machine from the configuration pairing $c$ with $d$, carrying the extra tapes and output $o$, equals the configuration formed from one step of $P$ from $c$, the new data state, each extra tape updated at the former position of head $h$ according to its write instruction, and the output word extended by the optional symbol.
hypotheses_covered: $D$ is finite and has decidable equality
$P$ is a finite Turing machine over $A$
$x$ is a list of symbols in $A$
$T_i$ gives the contents of each of the $l$ extra tapes
replaced:
Let $P$ be a machine over an alphabet $A$, decorated by a data transducer with $l$
extra tapes, designated head index $h$, initial data state, and visit function.  Let
$c$ be a configuration of $P$ on an input word $x$ whose control state is a live
state $q$, let $d$ be a data state, and fix contents for the $l$ data tapes and an
output word.  Write $v$ for the value of the visit function on $q$, $d$, the input
symbol scanned by $c$, the $k$ work-tape reads of $c$, and the data-tape symbols at
the position of the designated head $h$; thus $v$ consists of a new data state, one
optional write per data tape, and an optional emitted symbol.  Then one step of the
decorated machine from the decorated configuration equals the decorated configuration
built from one step of $P$ from $c$, the new data state, each data tape updated by
its optional write at the position of the designated head, and the output word
extended by the emitted symbol when one is present.  In particular the decorated
transition consists of exactly the prescribed schedule step together with the local
data visit.
